name: FormMorpheus
title: a stage over a timeline, drawn frame by frame, keyframed or performed live
summary: FormMorpheus is an animation studio: a Stage over a Timeline, with drawings, flipbooks, pictures, text, video and sound on tracks, offline and with no account.
lede: FormMorpheus puts the movie frame on a Stage above a Timeline of tracks, in one window with no account. You can draw each frame, set keyframes with easing, or perform a drag live and record it as keys. Drawings, flipbooks, pictures, text, video and sound sit on the tracks, and everything works offline.
checks: Shows the movie frame on a Stage above a Timeline of tracks, with a frame-accurate timecode.
Animates three ways: compose blocks on tracks, set keyframes with easing, or perform a drag live and record it as keys.
Draws frame by frame in flipbooks with holds and onion skins, plus a full paint canvas with a brush library.
Makes every edit an undo step saved inside the movie, with Recently Deleted and crash recovery.

facts.dd: .fmo files hold the movie, assets and undo history
A vanilla TypeScript and Vite interface, a Python and FastAPI engine and a Tauri 2 desktop shell
30 languages, right to left included, with a manual on F1
MP4, WebM, MOV, GIF and image frames; ProRes and HEVC export use your own ffmpeg

chapters.title: One screen for the whole movie
chapters.text: The movie frame sits above, tracks of content below, with a frame-accurate timecode. Drawings, flipbooks, pictures, video, sound, text, shapes, solids, adjustments and groups all live on the tracks.

chapters.title: Draw each frame and see its neighbours
chapters.text: Flipbooks hold each drawing as long as you need. Onion skins show the drawings before and after the current one as ghosts, and a full paint canvas with a brush library sits beside them.

chapters.title: Key it, or perform it
chapters.text: Keyframe mode keys Move and Scale and live filters on lanes under each block, with ease and hold curves between keys. In Perform, you drag a block on the Stage while the movie plays and the gesture becomes keys at the movie's frame rate.

requirements: Node 20.19 or newer, or 22.12 or newer
docs.install:
git clone git@github.com:nodemode-dev/formmorpheus.git
cd formmorpheus
./formmorpheus_oc_install
Windows: formmorpheus_oc_install.bat
docs.desktop: ./formmorpheus desktop dev opens the desktop window instead of the web UI. ./build_app builds the desktop app.

topics.title: Quick Start
topics.text: The README gives install and run commands for macOS, Linux and Windows. The web UI is at http://localhost:5194.

topics.title: Manual
topics.text: docs/MANUAL.md is the manual, also available in the app on F1.

topics.title: Configuration
topics.text: The interface runs on port 5194 and proxies /api to the engine on 127.0.0.1:9494. FORMMORPHEUS_DATA_DIR moves the engine's data and movie library, and FORMMORPHEUS_PORT sets the engine port.

topics.title: iPad
topics.text: The iPad app in ios/ wraps the same interface in a Swift shell with Apple Pencil, Files and AVFoundation export. It is written but not yet built on a Mac; see docs/ios/BUILD.md.

topics.title: Status
topics.text: In development. The Linux desktop build is tested; the macOS and Windows builds are configured but untested.
